name: Armv8-A Relaxed Virtual Memory
description: A Herd-style axiomatic concurrency model extending the base Armv8-A user model with virtual-memory and address-translation events (T translation-reads, TLBI, TE, ERET, MSR, DSB) and new relations (trf, tfr, iio, tob, obtlbi, ctxob, wco), in Strong and Weak variants, with soundness/metatheory proofs. For programs with stable, injectively-mapped address spaces it collapses exactly to the base Armv8-A user-mode concurrency model (Sec. 6); outside that fragment it admits additional executions arising from translation-table manipulation and TLB maintenance.

catSupport.note: Simner et al. give the virtual-memory model as a cat extension of the Armv8 model (translation-read, TLBI, DSB events), executable in Isla-axiomatic; herd7's aarch64.cat and aarch64bbm.cat carry the TLBI/break-before-make machinery.
